body:
Parent review: #496. This is a single-location source-restoration task; it does not alter any regional shared boundary or infer political ownership.

Exact subject: `gb:ECU:ADM2:8360857B1829680752404` (Las Golondrinas), current pinned parent Imbabura. Evidence in #496 PR #573: the 2019 geoBoundaries ADM2 reference calls it a canton under Imbabura; official INEC/OCHA 2023 ADM2 table lists EC9001 under `Zona No Delimitada`; the 2024 ADM2 gazetteer has no matching record. This is an effective-date and source-role conflict. Existing evidence does not establish current administrative status, source-vintage geometry or complete physical land coverage.

Acceptance:
- Obtain and retain dated primary INEC or other competent Ecuadorian authority evidence establishing current administrative status and effective date for this exact unit.
- Restore the full source geometry (or document a lawful, hash-verifiable restoration path) and record source attribution, license, bytes and SHA-256.
- Reconcile the whole-area geometry against current named physical land, islands and settlements without using current political ownership as geographic evidence.
- Record source-to-current geometry and neighboring consistency findings; if this crosses a regional boundary, coordinate with #489 and affected owners before proposing any correction.
- Return a sourced disposition or explicit unresolved findings with a further bounded action. Evidence and proposed corrections only; engineering integrates changes.

The related Manga del Cura / EC9003 finding is owned by #495 and is not assigned here. Coordinate with that issue only; do not duplicate its owned subject.
